name: ImgSlider
description: A text header (eyebrow with decoration + accent color, title with <strong> accent, description, optional CTA buttons) above an image/video gallery in one of five Figma layouts: single, grid, thumbs, fullbleed, or edge.
when_to_use: Project showcases, client galleries, or teaser rows where a headline introduces a set of visuals. For a single in-section image next to a paragraph use Section; for a full-bleed opener use Hero.
capabilities: five layout variants: single (1 image + arrows), grid (1 lead + tile grid, static), thumbs (main + thumbnail strip), fullbleed (viewport-wide 21:9), edge (cards peek past the right edge with a progress bar)
header alignment left/center/right — left pulls buttons top-right opposite the title
slides of image, uploaded video, or external video URL, with poster and caption overlay ("index / total · caption")
aspect ratio (auto, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9, 1:1) for single/grid/thumbs; fullbleed is 21:9, edge is square
arrows (single/fullbleed centered below, edge top-right), autoplay (6s, pauses on hover), loop
title <strong> emphasis rendered in the brand accent color

variants.description: One slide per view with a caption overlay and round arrows centered below. Default.
Static gallery: one large lead image plus a grid of square tiles (first 5 slides). No slider controls.
Main slide with a caption overlay and a thumbnail strip below; clicking a thumbnail changes the main image.
Slide track breaks out to the full viewport width at 21:9, caption overlay, arrows centered below.
Square cards run past the right container edge; arrows sit in the header row, a segmented progress bar + counter below.

breakpoints.mobile: Header stacks above the gallery; grid collapses to 2 columns; edge/thumbs scroll horizontally.
breakpoints.desktop: Left-aligned header renders buttons (and edge arrows) in the top-right of the header row.

ai.prompt_summary: ImgSlider: header + media gallery. Settings: variant (single|grid|thumbs|fullbleed|edge, matching Figma), eyebrow, eyebrow_decoration (none|bar|dot), eyebrow_color (7 semantic tokens), title (supports <strong> accent), description, text_align (left|center|right), aspect_ratio (auto|16/9|4/3|21/9|1/1; ignored by fullbleed=21/9 and edge=square), show_arrows, autoplay, loop; buttons[] (shared Factory Button spec). Content in slides[] (min 1): { type (image|video|video_url), image, video, video_url, poster, alt, caption }.
ai.content_guidelines: 3-6 slides. Captions one line, rendered as an overlay pill with an index counter. Keep <strong> emphasis to one phrase. Grid uses the first 5 slides (1 lead + 4 tiles).

field_hints.variant: Layout family; single/thumbs/fullbleed/edge are sliders, grid is a static composition.
field_hints.slides.type: Chooses which source field is read: image, video (upload), or video_url.
field_hints.slides.caption: Rendered as an overlay pill prefixed with 'index / total ·'.
field_hints.eyebrow_color: Semantic theme token; also drives the title <strong> accent.
